editorial:
Imagine you are in a relationship where you love your partner, but the idea of a wedding feels like a total trap. That is exactly where you find yourself with the main characters in this funny Italian comedy. It captures that awkward tension between wanting to be with someone forever and wanting to keep your freedom. The vibe is lighthearted and relatable, focusing on the small fights and big misunderstandings that happen when two people try to figure out if they are actually ready for the big day. You will feel like you are just hanging out with a couple of friends who are slightly stressing out about their future.

What really works here is the chemistry between the actors, making the banter feel natural rather than scripted. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though some of the jokes might feel a bit predictable if you have seen a lot of rom-coms. If you want a low-stress movie for a date night, this is a great pick. It is a cozy watch that does not ask too much from you.
endingExplained: In the end, the couple realizes that their fear of marriage was actually just a fear of changing who they are. After a series of funny arguments and a few close calls, they decide that they do not need a giant, traditional wedding to prove their love. They choose to commit to each other on their own terms. The movie wraps up with them happy and relaxed, proving that love is more important than a fancy party.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies about modern relationships.
